Gregor F
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam121 contributions

Excellent breakfast in Saigon
Feb 2020 • Couples
Le Café has a wide array of international dishes and also serves some Vietnamese standards. In my experience, everything is delicous and high quality, with very friendly, efficient, and multilingual service. The staff speak excellent English. The menu is also in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean (see photo).

Especially the breakfast (Monday–Friday 06:30–10:30 am, weekend 06:30–11:00 am) is great value at VND 350k++. Apart from the breakfast buffet, this includes as many hot drinks (Espresso, Americano, Caffè latte, Cappuccino, hoto chocolate etc.) and as many up plates as you would like from the breakfast menu. The breakfast buffet changes daily so you won't get bored. 

You can sign up for their membership free of charge and get a discount right away.

The restaurant is located inside Sherwood Suites hotel but open to outside guests as well.
